current.text: Rookie. The Bucks took him with the 13th pick of the 2026 draft.
Experts think the Bucks reached at 13. They say he was not worth that pick and might just be a bad player.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with an ankle injury.
He had a bad summer league: 10 points and 5 rebounds per game, only 0.4 blocks, and missed free throws.
His path to NBA minutes is weak right now.
He is not in the Bucks' projected opening lineup of Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner.
New coach Taylor Jenkins might use a deep rotation, and experts call the Bucks rotation one of the hardest to read.
The Bucks are expected to focus more on young players as the season goes on, which could open minutes for him later.
Experts expect the Bucks to be a bad team. They do not own their pick, so they have no reason to tank.
He is not a draft target in a 12-team league.

durable.text: Experts call his shooting and efficiency poor and doubt his scoring.
He has size, an interesting frame and scoring upside. He scored a lot and rebounded well before the NBA.
He could be a decent rebounder.
Experts doubt his steals, blocks, passing and usage. His block numbers are low for his size.
He might be an okay defender.
He had a back injury during summer league.

note: Ament is not a pick in our league. Yahoo ranks him 713 and ESPN 293, both value him at 0 USD, and his projected line is below the pool in almost every category. Yahoo projects about 10 points on 8.7 shots and ESPN about 6 points in under 18 minutes, but the experts doubt his shooting and his path to minutes. Leave him on waivers and check later in the season whether the Bucks' turn toward young players gives him a real role.
